IntroductionArchitectureExecutionsEvidenceEvolution

Research preview · 14 October 2026

Learning rules.
Testing their limits.

Can a learned digit-and-carry transition compose into reliable addition on unfamiliar lengths and unseen local contexts?

Engineering verified. Scientific study unrun.

R5.4 is a frozen experimental design for unsigned decimal addition. It compares a compact stateless model with a recurrent model using the same training tasks and loss policy. No R5.4 scientific fit or neural OOD prediction exists in the reviewed evidence.

The previous v1 engineering NO_GO remains preserved. A separate native qualification passed six configurations with 144 disposable optimizer steps and zero scientific updates. Gate adoption and scientific execution still require separate authorization.

The next digit.
The next carry.

A 22-feature observation goes in. Twelve unmasked logits come out. The model predicts the local transition; the scaffold advances the cursor.

↶ Predicted carry feeds the next column. It is not corrected by a verifier.

No persistent hidden state. Predict one digit and one carry from the current column.

Supplied procedure

Traversal is explicit.

Decimal parsing, least-significant-digit-first order, zero padding, initial carry, termination and output serialization are supplied. Learning does not discover these algorithmic steps.

Learned hypothesis

Local transitions must compose.

Digit and carry classification are learned. The second half of the proposed training mixes teacher-forced labels with labels for the model’s actually visited carry states. Whole-answer generalization remains untested.

Proposed schedule: 1,024 training tasks · seeds 11, 23, 47 · 800 updates per fit · final checkpoint only. These are protocol settings, not completed training. Frozen protocol ↗

02 / Model evolution

Different questions.
A continuous research record.

R5.2 tests mathematical procedures. R5.3 tests physical dynamics. R5.4 narrows the next mathematical hypothesis. Their version numbers do not form a shared performance leaderboard.

R5.2

Mathematical generalization

8.33% exact OOD

Recurrent three-seed mean. Reset-hidden reaches 25%. Local correctness does not guarantee whole-task composition.

Recovered · NO_GOFindings and limits ↗

R5.3

Physical world models

32step forecasts

Motion and interactions, uncertainty and executed planning. The structured model fails superiority against stronger controls.

Recovered · NO_GOFindings and limits ↗

R5.4

Compositional rule learning

—accuracy unmeasured

Unsigned addition, predicted-carry feedback and reserved local contexts. Scientific training has not run.

05 / What the record supports

Progress includes
the boundaries.

Works within scope

Inspectable execution.

Historical direct and kernel outcomes independently replay. R5.4 engineering qualification is verified. Source, data, checkpoints and predictions retain explicit provenance.

Failed scientific gates

Generalization remains hard.

R5.2 recurrence underperforms reset-hidden and memory controls. R5.3 structured physics does not establish superiority. Shared learning has not established useful cross-domain transfer.

Not yet tested

R5.4 learning.

Six scientific fits, neural OOD outputs and corrected paired tests remain unrun. A future result would apply to the frozen unsigned-addition study, not broad mathematics or cross-domain intelligence.
